title: Android on-device DSH runtime
description:
Native DSH provider implemented in the current UI cycle. Selecting On device opens the standard Niobium Home, Pixels, workshop and native chats. Engines switches between DSH and Hermes while retaining the saved Hermes connection; the local engine can continue alongside Hermes. A shared pinned-API adapter creates real reviewed DSH presets, restores sessions and pending requests, streams replies, selects models, and maps companion controls. API-key entry is native; the stock DSH web workspace, terminal and Stop are advanced controls. Five Android app-domain ARM64/API36 tests pass, including real preset creation, a controlled loopback model turn through DSH, native response streaming/history, native navigation with the engine running, authenticated HTTP/WebSocket access, Stop/restart and image/skill preservation. Android hard-link emulation fixes durable session publication. The full iOS simulator boots DSH into native Home/Scout; both iOS targets compile and 24 native unit plus 3 UI tests pass. Remaining acceptance: physical ARM64 and 16 KB pages, real-account provider/model/image cases, actual delegation, PTYs/native host bridges, OEM/background/battery/process-death coverage and a native provider vault. Local keys currently remain in app-private DSH home; local Pixels share a workspace. Documentation: https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/docs/DSH-PROVIDER.md Review fixes also preserve multi-select answers, transactional preset metadata, per-step streams, partial-turn recovery, snapshot/stream handoff, older transcript pages, all saved chat rows, full-log usage projections and failed-image cleanup. Eighteen shared adapter tests pass.

Physical iPhone follow-up (2026-10-22): development-signed full iOS 2.0 (7) updated the existing build 6 on an iPhone 18 Pro Max with iOS 27.0.1. The opt-in native DSH smoke test passed in 29.754 seconds: real Scout roster, enabled workshop entry, ready native Engines/API-key form, closed advanced WebView, Home-screen return and native Scout chat UI. No model request was sent and no provider key was changed. Full suspension/background, real-account turns, delegation, battery/process-death, accessibility and physical Android/16 KB checks remain. Sanitized evidence: https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/docs/evidence/ios-build7-device-smoke.json . Raw screenshots remain local because they include personal system UI.

title: Evaluate Harness2 for evidence-based Pixel improvement
description: User-linked Harness2 evaluated at google-research/harness2 commit 1cfe254e8d25b15f37048c3730134686abe60335, Apache-2.0, Python 3.12/3.13. Deterministic credential-free demo passed parallel and sequential recursion at k=2: two tasks, zero failures, 28 executions and 32 editor calls. Existing executors are OpenCode/Codex; Hermes/DSH needs a substrate adapter. Proposed next experiment: one bounded probe step per explicitly selected test task on PC/VPS, evidence-based persona/skill/delegation suggestions shown as a reviewed PixelSpec diff, versioned adoption and rollback. Keep secrets, connector authorization and enforced access outside the editable harness. Do not replay side-effecting tasks as probes. Acceptance: real Hermes adapter, independent outcome checks, budget/cancellation/reconnect/partial-failure coverage, evidence redaction and unchanged access. Not integrated or shipped as a mobile runtime. Source and plan: https://github.com/google-research/harness2 and https://github.com/wckdboy/niobium/blob/main/PLAN.md.
